passages.title: Campaign budget
passages.text:
Marcus Lee (2:10 P.M.): The survey results are in. 62 percent of respondents first heard about us on social media.
Priya Shah (2:12 P.M.): That's higher than I expected. Should we move some of the print budget?
Marcus Lee (2:14 P.M.): I'd say so, but the brochures still matter for our hotel partners.
Priya Shah (2:15 P.M.): Fair. What if we cut the print run in half and put the savings into video ads?
Marcus Lee (2:17 P.M.): That works for me. Can you draft a proposal by Thursday?
Priya Shah (2:18 P.M.): Sure. Should I include the cost of the video studio?
Marcus Lee (2:19 P.M.): Yes, and don't forget the freelancer's fee. Money is tight this quarter.

questions.q: What will Ms. Shah probably do by Thursday?

why.vi: Ông Lee nhờ "draft a proposal by Thursday" và cô Shah đồng ý "Sure".
why.en: Mr. Lee asks for a proposal by Thursday and Ms. Shah agrees.

questions.trap: Cô chỉ tính cả chi phí studio vào đề xuất, chưa thuê gì.

questions.q: At 2:14 P.M., what does Mr. Lee most likely mean when he writes, "the brochures still matter"?
options: Hotel partners still depend on printed materials.

why.vi: Ông đồng ý chuyển ngân sách nhưng vẫn muốn giữ tờ rơi vì các đối tác khách sạn cần chúng.
why.en: He accepts the shift but notes that hotel partners still need printed brochures.

questions.trap: Ông không phủ nhận mạng xã hội, ông còn nói "I'd say so" tức đồng ý chuyển ngân sách.

questions.q: Which cost does Mr. Lee ask Ms. Shah to include besides the video studio?

why.en: Mr. Lee reminds her to include the freelancer's fee.

questions.trap: Chi phí in tờ rơi sẽ giảm, nhưng không phải khoản ông nhắc thêm.
